name: How long does ground-up home construction typically take?
description: Ground-up home construction typically takes 10 to 18 months, not including design and permitting.

mainEntity.name: How long does ground-up home construction typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for ground-up home construction varies significantly based on factors like the size and complexity of the home, site conditions, permitting processes, weather, and material availability. On average, a custom home can take anywhere from 10 to 18 months from groundbreaking to move-in. This estimate does not include the design and permitting phase, which can add several months before physical construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ground-up home construction typically takes 10 to 18 months, not including design and permitting.
